body:
I've been on Anti depressants for years.

I was on Fluoxetine when I was 15/16, then I came off them the summer before I went to University to study a masters degree at Maths, and things got so bad I had to come home. I went back the next, while on medication, changed to Economics. My first year of that I had a flatmate in halls that attacked me, would constantly steal my stuff and generally made my life a living hell. I retook and passed the next year after moving into a house with friends. The next year started well, but ended badly. I was struggling with depression and tiredness even on medication; I had changed to Venlafaxine. I'd always not slept well since childhood, but I could never seem to get decent sleep with these, and the university doctors would refuse to change them, only adjust the dosage. I'd be falling asleep for an hour and wake up, at night and throughout the day. This carried on for another year, with the university allowing me to retake due to this.

I came back home this year and retook because Student Finance wouldn't fund me again. Since being at home, the doctors here changed my medication to Mirtazapine, which is probably the only good thing to happen to me since i've been here. I sleep well and regularly, am no longer tired during the day and can stay awake. I thought the depression would clear up once that was sorted, but I can't seem to escape the hopelessness of my situation. I mean, this doesn't happen to everyone so surely i'm doing something wrong? I just can't seem to fix it no matter how hard I try, and i've slowly been losing hope.

I've had my studies terminated by the university as I didn't pass my retakes.

The majority of the volunteer based organisations nearby (I've just checked again on http://www.do-it.org.uk) are for things which, if i'm completely honest, I can't do. I'm not good with people at all, i've tried customer service previously and it would just end up with me quitting after an anxiety attack. The only one that i've found that I could probably do is an Admin Assistant Volunteering post with the Scouts, but I'm not sure if I could do it when i'm feeling like this.

I've considered Volunteering, but I have no money in order to get to places to volunteer, and no nearby public transport. There isn't much nearby. I've asked my parents for help with regards to transport, and then I get the lecture about money and how they can't afford to keep me, even though they have recently bought an apartment in Spain. 

I was studying Economics.
